text: {"lessons":["Selling winning positions has felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to trim based on my target allocation, not just the gain over my average cost.","I made several purchases after prices had fallen, including large buys in Stock B and Stock E; a lower price alone is not evidence of a better opportunity, so I should size trades carefully and preserve diversification.","My account value moved up and down despite periods with no trades, reminding me that frequent action cannot control random price changes; I should follow a consistent plan rather than react to each fluctuation."]}
